# Jade Angco — portfolio and blog, written for AI search and answer engines.

> Front-End Developer (SvelteKit, Vue.js, Nuxt) and website hosting provider
> based in Poblacion, Bislig City, Surigao del Sur 8311, Philippines.
> Currently a Contract-of-Service Programmer at a Local Government Unit;
> freelancing part-time, remote worldwide. Typically replies within 24 hours.

## What he offers

- Front-end development with SvelteKit, Vue.js/Nuxt, TailwindCSS, TypeScript
- Website hosting & DevOps: Nginx, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS, SSL, uptime monitoring
- Takeovers, fixes, migrations, and ongoing maintenance of existing sites
- Live proof: 5 client websites hosted and monitored (see /#live-sites)
